svg.title: Плавание кролем — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Freestyle front crawl in water, elevated side view, no gym equipment. Full body horizontal face-down near a fine water surface line. Left: near arm recovering above water with bent elbow, far arm extended forward in water. Right: near arm extended forward entering water, far arm pulls back below surface. Straight body, small alternating flutter kick. No bench, no filled water. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
